mapper.select: select cpl.Cpl_Sort as cpltdSort, cpl.Cpl_Parent_Id as cpltdParentId, cpl.Cpl_Administration_Url as cpltdAdministrationUrl, cpl.Cpl_Administration_Url_H as cpltdAdministrationUrlH, wn.* from Project_Cpl_Template_Dtl wn left join Project_Cp_Library cpl on cpl.Cpl_Id=wn.Cpltd_Cpl_Id where wn.Cplt_Id=#{cpltId} order by cpl.Cpl_Sort asc
